Commentary.Commentary: We are back! Haseebullah Khan and Muhammad Shehzad are the openers! Tom Whitney has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE CHASE ...

Now Pakistan do have some decent batters but Australia have some good pacers as well. The wicket is slightly on the slower side but still good for batting. However, runs on the board in a knockout game are always good. A good second half awaits.

Corey Miller is down for a chat. He says he is happy with the total, all the boys did well, and they back themselves with the ball as well. Mentions that the batters can score well on this wicket, but there is something for the bowlers also.  Adds that they have a game on their hands, but again he is confident about his team's bowling. Concludes by saying that it's been an amazing experience, to represent Australia in West Indies.

Pakistan could not make most of the favourable bowling conditions early on! They got the ball to swing but could not manage to take wickets. The spinners later were tackled well as there were a lot of sweep shots played to good effect. Pakistan bowlers did have a good passage of play from over 35 to 45 but they will be disappointed they let Australia cross the 270-run mark in the end. Overall, they will feel, they are behind in the game at the moment.

That is a really good batting performance from Australia and they will be mighty pleased with how things stand at the moment! The openers are the ones who set the tone with an 86-run stand. The two weathered the storm early and then played really smartly. Once Campbell Kellaway fell, Miller along with Teague Wyllie added another 101-run stand. At that time 300 seemed possible but Pakistan then managed to take wickets at regular intervals and that stemmed the run-flow. However, a few cameos towards the end from William Salzmann and Cooper Connolly has powered them to a total which is probably above par.
A bye to end! Outside off, Tom swings but misses. The sneak a run as it goes to the keeper. 14 from the final over then and AUSTRALIA END WITH 276!
A yorker now on middle, Snell swings, he gets an inside edge onto the pads, it rolls on the leg side for one.
Two now! A low full toss outside off, Snell hits it wide of long off for two.

OUT! NOW A WICKET! Not sure why he tried to be cheeky when he could hit it so long standing still! Tries to play the paddle scoop, it goes off the splice and the man at short fine leg takes an easy catch. A good cameo from William.
Commentary.Howout: c Ahmed Khan b Awais Ali

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED AND FOUR! Costly, Australia already have a good score and giving away such bonus runs is not what Pakistan want. The fielder misjudged it completely! A slower one on middle, William swings, it goes more off the higher part of the bat. The fielder at deep mid-wicket runs to his left and then forward but then realises the wind is taking it behind him. He looks to take it reverse cup above his head but it bursts through and goes behind for a boundary. 10 from the first two balls.
SIX! This guy is strong! He can really hit it a long way. This is also with the wind. Shorter and on middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a long one.
Full and outside off. William Salzmann drills it past cover for a single.
SIX! PUINSHED! Very full, outside off, slower delivery. William Salzmann smokes this over long off for a biggie!
Yorker, on middle. Tobias Snell squeezes it out to mid on for a single.
Length ball, slower this time. William Salzmann drills it down to long off for a single.
Very full ball, around off. William Salzmann squeezes it towards mid off. No run there.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper has thrown his wicket away! He tried to be innovative here. A fuller ball, outside off. Cooper Connolly walks across and tries to scoop this over short fine leg. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat towards Awais Ali at short fine leg, who slides forward and completes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Awais Ali b Zeeshan Zameer

Commentary.Commentary: Another one! Outside off, Cooper slaps it through covers for one.
A dot! Dots are gold! Shorter and outside off, Cooper looks to cut but misses.
William makes room and he is followed. He pushes it to covers for one.
Another run! On middle, this is hit through mid-wicket for one.

EDGY FOUR! Boundaries flowing off the bat of Cooper Connolly now! This one edgy but he won't care. 250 up, still over 2 overs to go. Outside off, Connolly throws his bat at it, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
A yorker now on middle, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
FOUR! Cut away! This time to the right of the fielder in the deep but he again had no chance! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Welcome boundary! A full toss outside off, Connolly smashes it through covers. This one races away to the fence.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, the slower one does not come out right. Left alone.
Another single! This is hit hard though. Outside off, this is smashes through covers but to the sweeper for one.
Another short one, a slower one, holds in the surface a touch. Cooper looks to cut but underedges it on the off side. A run taken.
Just the one! Singles won't harm Pakistan! On off, this is hit hard towards mid off for one.
Full toss, outside off. William Salzmann slashes this towards point.
Another fuller ball, outside off. William Salzmann knocks it down to mid off for a quick single.
Fuller ball, around middle. William Salzmann leans and tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.

NOT OUT! That could have gone either way! We feel it is a fair call in the end. There is no conclusive evidence to actually say that it has hit the stumps directly! This is on off, Cooper pushes it towards cover and then takes off. The fielder fires it towards the keeper. Not sure if he takes the ball and whips the bails off or it is a direct hit but Pakistan start celebrating as the batter seems well short. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that when the ball passes close to the stumps, the gloves too are really close to the leg pole. Can't really say if it has just clipped the stumps or is it the gloves. In the end, it is given in the favor of the batter.

Is that a run out? There is a throw at the keeper's end. The umpires are checking it is a direct hit or not. The replay rolls in and shows that when the ball passes close to the stumps, the gloves too are really close to the leg pole. NOT OUT says the third umpire! No conclusive evidence to say if that was a direct hit or not.
Fires this full and outside off, Cooper slashes but misses.
Who will walk to bat now?

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! This is a good passage of play for Pakistan! This is tossed up outside off, Cahill comes down the track and looks to go over long on. It goes more off the toe-end and the fielder at long on takes the catch. He probably should have tried to hit that over the off side.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Shehzad b Mehran Mumtaz

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Very full, outside off. Aidan Cahill pushes it towards mid off.
Excellent running! On a length, around middle. Aidan Cahill taps it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Good come back! A yorker, around off. Aidan Cahill fails to squeeze this one out.
SIX! BANG! Zeeshan Zameer drops it short again, on middle. Aidan Cahill slaps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Back of a length, outside off. Cooper Connolly guides it to third man for a single.
Touch fuller, around middle. Aidan Cahill pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Touch shorter, around middle. Aidan Cahill flicks it to square leg for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Aidan Cahill looks to pull this but misses.
Length delivery, around middle. Aidan Cahill works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter ball, around middle. Aidan Cahill waits for it and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, around offf. Aidan Cahill knocks it to cover.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Aidan Cahill clips it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
Another shorter ball, around off. Aidan Cahill taps it towards point and takes a quick single. End of a very good spell by the skipper.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cooper Connolly slices this it to point for a single.
Another fuller delivery, around middle. Aidan Cahill eases it to long off for a single. He gets off the mark with that run.
Loopy ball, around off. Aidan Cahill blocks it out.
Aidan Cahill comes to the crease now.

OUT! LBW! Pakistan Under-19 are taking things under control here! They have fought back well and have now picked up their fourth wicket! Full delivery, on middle. Lachlan Shaw gets low and goes for the reverse-sweep, but misses and gets rapped on the back pad. A huge shout and the umpire raises his finger. Lachlan Shaw walks back early!
Fuller ball, on middle. Cooper Connolly knocks it down to long off for a single.
Yorker-length delivery, around off. Lachlan Shaw fails to squeeze this one out. A maiden over by Awais Ali!
Shorter ball, around off. Lachlan Shaw knocks it to cover. Another dot ball.

Overpitches this one, on middle. Lachlan Shaw blocks it back to the bowler. Awais Ali collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. Lachlan Shaw turns back quickly and dives in to make his ground.
Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Lachlan Shaw digs it out towards point.
Fuller ball, on off. Lachlan Shaw pushes it back to the bowler.
Full toss, on middle. Lachlan Shaw clips it to mid-wicket.
Touch shorter, around off. Cooper Connolly taps it to point. End of a successful over by Qasim Akram.
FOUR! Shot! Short ball, outside off. Cooper Connolly hangs back and cuts that towards deep point for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, on middle. Cooper Connolly pushes it back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan Under-19 have got the wicket of another set batsman here! Fuller ball, around off. Corey Miller looks to for the big one on the off side but miscues his shot towards long off. Irfan Khan there takes an easy catch to dismiss Corey Miller!
Commentary.Howout: c Irfan Khan b Qasim Akram

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Outside off, touch shorter. Corey Miller looks to heave this, but misses.

Shorter ball, outside off. Corey Miller cuts it to deep cover and the cross runs. There is a throw at the bowler's end, but Qasim Akram fails to collect it and the batters steal an overthrow in return as well.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now a total of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Length ball, on the pads this time. Cooper Connolly looks to flick this away but gets a leading edge towards point. No run there.
Outside off, length. Cooper Connolly slices it towards deep cover for a brace.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Corey Miller opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man. A single taken.
Quick single! Length, on the pads. Cooper Connolly taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. One run taken.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Cooper Connolly, on back foot, pushes it towards cover.
A length ball, around middle. Corey Miller stays in his crease and slices it towards third man for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Corey Miller drills it to long off for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Corey Miller pulls it towards mid-wicket.
Another one outside off, touch shorter. Cooper Connolly slashes this towards deep cover for a single.
Tad quicker, outside off. Cooper Connolly looks to defend this but gets an outside edge past the short third man fielder for a couple of runs.
Wide of off again, shorter. Cooper Connolly hangs back and cuts it past point for a brace.
Quicker, wide of off. Corey Miller chops it towards cover for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Corey Miller clips it to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Cooper Connolly drives it towards mid off for a single, He gets off the mark with that.

OUT! TIMBER! Finally a breakthrough for Pakistan Under-19! Much needed wicket this and Teague Wyllie has to depart after an excellent innings! A yorker-length delivery, on middle. Teague Wyllie walks across and tries to flic this but gets beaten on the pace. The ball goes and crashes onto the stumps. Good decision to bring back Awais Ali, he strikes at the right time!
Good-length delivery, around off. Corey Miller slices it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Runs are coming quickly here! Corey Miller is not missing out on anything! Another overpitched delivery, on middle. Corey Miller lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Corey Miller drives it towards cover. The fielder there dives to his right and , makes a brilliant stop. No run taken.
Awais Ali is back on!
Shorter ball, around middle. Corey Miller pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! FIFTY up in style! Corey Miller overpitches this one, around off. Corey Miller waits for it and tonks it over mid on for a biggie!
Fuller ball, around off. Teague Wyllie knocks it down to mid on for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Corey Miller whips it towards fine leg for a single.
WIDE! shorter ball, down the leg side. Corey Miller goes for the pull but misses. Wide called.

FOUR! Corey Miller takes the aerial route this time! Very full, on middle. Corey Miller lofts it over mid off. The fielder there runs back and tries to stop it but fails, the ball bounces on his knee and crosses the boundary ropes.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Outside off, very full. Corey Miller reaches out for it and goes for the drive, but he gets an outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
DRINKS! Australia Under-19 continues to cruise away! They are scoring at a rapid rate and now Pakistan Under-19 is still in a need of a wicket.
Fuller ball, around middle. Corey Miller knocks it long off for a single.
Quicker, outside off. Corey Miller pushes it towards extra cover for a single.
Swing and a miss! A loopy ball, outside off. Corey Miller gets low and looks to sweep this, but misses.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Corey Miller drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Fuller, outside off. Corey Miller drives but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Quicker ball, on the pads. Teague Wyllie knocks it to long on for a single.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked towards the right of the wicket for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, Miller guides it straight to poin this time who fields it.
FOUR! Through the legs and into the fence! Pakistan just do not seem up for this! Outside off, this is carved towards point. The fielder there lets it through his legs and it races away.
Quick run again! On off, Wyllie plays it towards cover and gets to the other end.
On off, this is driven through covers for one.
Zeeshan Zameer (4-0-19-0) is back on!
Lovely fielding! On middle, this is swept hard through square leg. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right, dives and keeps it down to two.
On off, blocked.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Another single! Outside off, this time slower, it is played through covers.
Sees the batter come down the track and fires it outside off, it is played to covers.
On off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Mehran Mumtaz (6-0-24-0) is brought back into the attack.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
FOUR! Runs coming thick and fast now! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point. This races away to the fence. 150 up.
On off, this is worked down to long on for one.
Angled into middle, this is eased down to long on for one more.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

FOUR! And again! Pakistan Under-19 need to find answers to his sweep shots! Fuller ball, around middle. Teague Wyllie gets low and slog-sweeps this wide of deep square leg for the second boundary in the over.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Teague Wyllie digs it out back to the bowler.
Shorter, on middle. Corey Miller knocks it to long on for a single.
Another shorter ball, around off. Teague Wyllie knocks it towards deep cover for a single.
Shorter, around off. Teague Wyllie pushes it to cover.
FOUR! SWEPT AWAY! A fuller ball, around middle. Teague Wyllie shuffles and across and swipes this towards deep square leg for a boundary. He has been playing the sweep very well!
A single to end as this is eased down to long off.
Another single as Miller strokes it to long off.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Again looks to play the reverse sweep, this is bowled outside off. He misses. Teague is looking to up the ante now.
A single as this is driven through covers.
On off, defended.
This time he connects with the sweep, hits it hard towards deep square leg. The fielder runs to his left and stops it. Two taken.
A loud appeal but nothing! Full and outside off, the batter looks to sweep but nothing.
Shorter and on off, Miller pushes it through covers for one.
BEATEN! Flatter and outside off, this one goes on with the arm. Miller looks to defend but is beaten.
4 dots in a row now! On middle, Miller plays it back to the bowler.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Another dot to end! On off, defended.
The reverse sweep comes out, it is hit to the point fielder. Strugling to the find the gaps at the moment.
A single now as this is pushed down to long on.
Fifty for Teague! Really good innings so far and his good form continues. A big score is on the offing here. He gets there by easing this down to long off for one.
On off, this is played back to the bowler.
Almost drags it on! Shorter and outside off, Miller looks to cut, this one stays low. It goes off the underedge and just past the off pole and down towards fine leg for one.
Abbas Ali comes into the attack.
The sweep is out, this time he hits it to backward square leg. Two dots to end. Runs hard to come by at the moment.
On off, defended.
On the shorter side, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Steps out now and eases it down to long off for one.
Shorter and on off, Wyllie mistimes it to covers.
Slows it up outside off, Teague looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, blocked.
Another one on the shorter side, Miller cuts but can't beat point.
Shortish and on off, Miller guides it to point.
Takes one now as he pushes it through covers.
On middle, Wyllie defends it on the off side.
Flatter and on middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Flatter ball, around the pads. Corey Miller flicks it to square leg for a single.
WIDE! Down the side again. Corey Miller looks to sweep but misses. Wide called.
WIDE! Quicker this time, down the leg side. Corey Miller misses his glance and wide called.
Quicker this time outside off. Corey Miller taps it towards point. No run there.
Loopy ball, around middle. Teague Wyllie sweeps this one towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Corey Miller works it towards long on.
Tosses this one up, around middle. Teague Wyllie sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Corey Miller clips it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller, around off. Teague Wyllie blocks it out.
Beaten! Outside off, fuller in length. Teague Wyllie looks to defend this s but misses.
Shout for LBW but turned down! A fuller ball, spinning it on middle. Teague Wyllie looks to pull this away but misses and gets hit on the pad. Height the issue here, maybe.
Quicker, arounnd middle. Teague Wyllie covers the line and defends it out.
Another short ball, outside off. Corey Miller chops it past the point fielder this time for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Corey Miller rocks back and cuts it towards point.
Fuller ball, on middle. Teague Wyllie leans and blocks it out.
Quicker this time, outside off. Corey Miller taps it to point for a single.
Shorter this time, around middle. Corey Miller pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full, outside off. Corey Miller guides it past point for a brace.
Loopy ball this time, around middle. Corey Miller blocks it out.
Flatter ball, around off. Corey Miller taps it to point.
FOUR! Fuller ball, outside off. Teague Wyllie drives it towards deep extra cover for a boundary. Awais Ali does well to slide and stop the ball, but he is in contact with the ropes in the process.
Fuller, around off. Teague Wyllie gets an underage towards the keeper.
Shorter ball, around middle. Teague Wyllie clips it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, on a shorter length. Teague Wyllie blocks it on the off side.
Shorter, around middle. Teague Wyllie pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker, around off. Corey Miller taps it to point for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.

DROPPED! A chance goes begging! Fuller ball, outside off. Corey Miller leans looks to drive this, but the ball goes out the outside edge towards point. The fielder there dives to his right but fails to grab it. One run taken.
Tad quicker, outside off. Corey Miller hangs back and looks to cut this away, but misses.
Tosses this up, full in length. Teague Wyllie once again sweeps this towards deep square leg. A single taken.
Fuller ball, outside of. Corey Miller leans and looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards third man for a single. 100 up for Australia Under-19!
Shorter ball, wide of off. Teague Wyllie cuts it towards point for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Teague Wyllie drives it to cover for a single.
Loopy ball, full in length. Teague Wyllie once again sweeps this but finds the fielder at deep square leg.
Around off. Teague Wyllie blocks this one.
FOUR! Crunched! A fuller ball, outside off. Teague Wyllie shuffles across and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Quicker again, full in length. Teague Wyllie gets an inside edge back on the pads.
Flatter, quicker. Teague Wyllie blocks it out.
Shorter and on off, Miller cuts but to point. Pakistan have managed to stem the run flow here.
Another loud appeal but that is going down leg! Fired on the pads, Miller looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
On middle, defended.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Loud shout but that is never going to be given! Wyllie gets outside the line of off and then tries to sweep, he misses and gets hit on the pad.
Tossed up on off, Wyllie plays it on the off side.
On middle, blocked.
Big turn! This lands on off and then spins away sharply. Miller looks to defend but then bails out.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, Teague pushes it through covers and takes one.
Flatter and on off, Miller pushes it through covers for one.
Sees the batter come down the track and shortens the length. Defended.
Another one, flighted and on off, defended.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the stumps, defended.
Tossed up on off, Miller plays it back to the bowler.
Mehran Mumtaz is back on! Change of ends for him!
A dot to end a wicket taking over! On middle, Wyllie works it to mid-wicket.
Miller is off the mark! Not the ideal ball first up to the new batter. A full toss on the pads, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Corey Miller walks in to bat at number 3.

OUT! STUMPED! There is wicket number one, Pakistan had to wait a long time to get it but they eventually do! The off spinner brings about the breakthrough. A good innings from Campbell Kellaway comes to an end. He falls 3 short of a half ton. The openers were looking to dominate the spinners and Campbell Kellaway looks to do that again. After three dots, he tries to create something, steps out but does not get to the pitch of the ball. He still swings, the ball turns away and the the keeper does the rest. A welcome wicket for Pakistan, can they build on this now?
Commentary.Howout: st Haseebullah Khan b Qasim Akram

Commentary.Commentary: Again on middle, Campbell plays it on the off side.
Fuller and on middle, this is driven back to the bowler.
Angled into middle, blocked.
Qasim Akram (1-0-5-0) brings himself back on!
Flatter and on off, defended nicely.
FOUR! Powerfully swept and the runs continue to flow! Wyllie gets outside the line of off, this is bowled outside off, he sweeps it hard through square leg and it races away to the fence.
Really good running! On off, this is played on the off side for one.
On the pads, Wyllie sweeps it through square leg for one.
On off, defended.
Short and coming in with the arm, Wyllie looks to cut but underedges it on the off side.

DRINKS! Australia are in a commanding position here! Their openers have played brilliantly and have laid the platform for a good score. More of the same is what they would want after the break. Pakistan on the other hand, need wickets and will hope the break works for them. The ball is spinning and they will hope the spinners can do their bit. An important phase coming up for them. Also, Maaz Sadaqat comes into the attack.
Shorter this time, outside off. Teague Wyllie pushes it towards cover-point for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Teague Wyllie gets low and looks to sweep this one but misses.
Loopy ball, around off. Campbell Kellaway taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end. The fielder fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters complete the run safely.
Quicker through the air this time, on the pads. Teague Wyllie taps it towards square leg for a single.
ANother shorter ball, outside off this time. Campbell Kellaway slashes this towards point for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Mehran Mumtaz drops it short this time, around middle. Campbell Kellaway picks up the length, waits for it, and slaps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Another shorter one, around middle. Campbell Kellaway works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway looks to slash this away but gets beaten.
Shorter again, around middle. Campbell Kellaway pulls it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short again, around middle. Campbell Kellaway pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Short again, spraying it down the leg side. Campbell Kellaway missed his flick, the ball brushes off the pads and goes to the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Teague Wyllie dabs it towards point for a single.

Another mix up! Tad fuller, on the pads. Campbell Kellaway nudges it towards square leg. The non-striker leaves his crease, but he is sent back. There is a throw at the non-striker's end, but that has missed the stumps. Direct hit would have been curtains for Teague Wyllie!
Touch shorter, around middle. Campbell Kellaway works it away towards square leg.
FOUR! Edgy! Outside off, touch fuller. Campbell Kellaway looks to push this away but gets an outside edge towards third man for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Shorter ball, spinning it in on the pads. Campbell Kellaway taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. He is sent back by his partner. The fielder grabs the ball and throws it to the keeper, who whips the bails off. Campbell Kellaway puts in a dive. The replay rolls in and shows the batter has just made his ground.
Is that a run out? The bat seems in the air. That is a close call. Maybe the benifit will be given to the batter.
Fuller, around middle. Campbell Kellaway leans and blocks it towards square leg.
Outside off, shorter. Campbell Kellaway stays in his crease and blocks it out.
WIDE! Sharp spin straightaway! Shorter ball, spinning it in, down the leg side. Campbell Kellaway lets that go through. Wide called.
Mehran Mumtaz comes into the attack.
Shorter ball, around middle. Campbell Kellaway pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Teague Wyllie works it away towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Campbell Kellaway looks to tuck this one on the leg side, but the gets an outside edge towards point. One run taken.
Fraction shorter, around the off pole. Campbell Kellaway covers the line and blocks it out off the back foot.
Back of a length, around middle. Campbell Kellaway miscues his pull to mid on. No run taken.
Awais Ali serves a fuller ball, outside off. Teague Wyllie leans and drives this towards cover-point for a single.
Tad slower, length and around middle. Teague Wyllie tucks it towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike.
A length this time, around off. Teague Wyllie shows the full face of his bat and defends it out.
WIDE! Full in length, shaping away, wide of off. Teague Wyllie leaves it alone and wide called.
Good running! Tad fuller, around off. Teague Wyllie shuffles across and taps it towards fine leg for a brace.
Another length ball, width on offer this time. Campbell Kellaway chops it towards deep point for a single.
Length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway knocks it to the fielder at cover-point.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Campbell Kellaway works ti away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Fuller, around off. Teague Wyllie shuffles across and taps it towards mid on. A little fumble there, allow the batters to take two runs. That brings up the 50 for Australia Under-19!
Outside off, on a length. Campbell Kellaway cuts it away towards deep point. The fielder from third man runs to his left, slides, and makes a good stop. One run taken.
On a length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway, on back foot, pushes it towards cover.
Another full toss, around middle. Campbell Kellaway works it away past mid-wicket for a brace.
WIDE! Touch shorter, down the leg side. Campbell Kellaway misses his glance and a wide is called.
A full toss this time, around middle. Campbell Kellaway clips it towards square leg.
Awais Ali begins with a fuller delivery, around middle. Campbell Kellaway pushes it back to the bowler.
Touch fuller, around middle. Teague Wyllie clips it towards square leg. Dot to end the over.

FOUR LEG BYES! Not great bowling this by Ahmed Khan! Spraying it again down the leg side, on a length. Teague Wyllie looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes off his thigh pad and races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Touch shorter, around the thigh pads. Campbell Kellaway works it away towards fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Good-length delivery, firing it down the leg side. Campbell Kellaway misses his flick and a wide is called.
Wide of off, very full. Campbell Kellaway leans and goes for the drive, but misses. An appeal for caught behind, but the umpire is unmoved.
On a length, around middle. Campbell Kellaway nudges it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
A stifled appeal for LBW, but turned down. Tad fuller, shaping it into the pads. Campbell Kellaway misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. That was probably sliding down leg.
FOUR! HAMMERED! That sounded so sweet as soon as it left the bat! Short ball, on middle. Teague Wyllie hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Swing and a miss! Very full, width on offer this time, a hint of away movement as well. Teague Wyllie leans and looks to drive this one, but fails to get any bat on it.
Length, outside off. Teague Wyllie pushes it towards cover. No run taken.
Outside off, on a length. Campbell Kellaway dabs it towards third man rotates the strike.
Another length ball, on the pads. Campbell Kellaway hangs back and taps it towards the fielder at square leg.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Campbell Kellaway flicks it towards square leg.
Wide of off again, fuller ball. Campbell Kellaway pushes this one, but he gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Very full, and wide of off. Campbell Kellaway drives this one but finds the fielder at cover.
Tad fuller, outside off. Campbell Kellaway does not fiddle with this one.
On a length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway leaves it alone.
Sloppy work! On a length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway lunges and drives it towards cover. Irfan Khan there bends to stop the ball but fails to grab it. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Glorious shot! Ahmed Khan serves a fuller-length delivery, outside off. Campbell Kellaway leans and drives it past mid off for a beautiful boundary.
Tighter line this time. Good-length delivery, around off. Teague Wyllie blocks this one out.
And once again, width on offer, shorter length. Teague Wyllie cuts it past cover-point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide of off. Teague Wyllie stays in his crease and slaps this towards deep point for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around middle this time. Teague Wyllie tries to defend this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man.
Shorter ball, outside off. Teague Wyllie, on back foot, blocks it out towards cover.
Beaten! Back of a length, nipping back in on middle. Teague Wyllie was looking to cut this away, but gets beaten as the ball comes back in sharply and hits him on the near the stomach area.
Tad fuller, outside off. Campbell Kellaway drives and gets an outside edge past point for two runs.
On a length, outside off. Campbell Kellaway stays in his crease and blocks it out solidly. 5 dot balls in a row now.
Fuller this time, angling it in, outside off. Campbell Kellaway drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Another length delivery, outside the off pole. Campbell Kellaway shoulders his arms at it. Another dot ball.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Campbell Kellaway leaves it alone.
Touch fuller, outside off. Campbell Kellaway leans and pushes it towards point. No run there.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Hammered, that has been pulled away with through square leg for a boundary.
Angled into the pads, Teague looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes to the keeper who dives and stops it.
On off, kept out.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Yet another beauty! Angled it into the off pole, gets it to leave the batter after pitching. Wyllie is beaten as he tries to defend. Good movement early on for the bowlers.
Now gets the ball to move away. It lands on off and seams away. Campbell is beaten as he tries to block.
This one is well wide outside off, he tries to get it back in but no swing. Left alone.
That has gone just over the middle pole. Length and this swings back in late from off. Campbell is cut into half as he tries to block. The extra bounce saves him as it goes over middle.
Fuller and on off, Campbell drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller again and on off, once again a wee bit of shape into the batter. It is played back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shot! Full and tailing back in from off. Campbell gets his front pad out of the way and flicks it brilliantly through mid-wicket.
Beaten! Outside off, on a length. Teague Wyllie looks to defend this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Touch fuller, on the pads. Teague Wyllie tucks it towards square leg.
Good-length delivery, shaping away from outside off. Teague Wyllie hangs back and looks to have a poke at it, but bails out in the end.
Very full, outside off. Teague Wyllie drives it to the fielder at mid off.

An appeal but that has pitched outside leg. On the pads, Campbell looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. They go for a run, the striker is late to take off but since it is away from the fielder. An easy leg bye.

FOUR! It is lore off the outer half! First boundary of the game.  Fuller and on off, it shapes away. Campbell looks to drive, it goes off the outer half through point and races away. The outfield seems really quick.
A quick run to end the first! On middle, Campbell looks to defend. It goes off the inner half on the leg side for one.
Close! This one is quicker and it comes back in with the angle from outside off. Campbell looks to cut but misses. It goes just past the off pole.
Quicker and on off, kept out.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Shorter, outside off. Teague Wyllie chips it towards point. The fielder fails to grab the ball and the batters pick up a single.

Run straightaway! Qasim Akram begins with a flatter ball, on the pads. Campbell Kellaway hangs back and tucks it towards deep square leg for three runs. Campbell Kellaway and Australia Under-19 are up and running!

We are ready for live-action. Pakistan Under-19 players are seen to be in a huddle near the ropes before they break out to their fielding positions. Teague Wyllie and Campbell Kellaway will open the batting for Australia Under-19. Qasim Akram will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
Both teams line up for the national anthem. The national anthem of Australia will be played first followed by Pakistan's.

PITCH REPORT -  Niall O'Brien is down near the pitch. He says the wicket looks wonderful. He adds that it's a good batting track, with no grass and it's a flat pitch and should be a batting paradise. Mentions that the batters are going to enjoy today, and as far as the bowlers are concerned, he says that they can't afford to be full. Also says that don't think it's going to spin much but the dimensions should help them.

Cooper Connolly, the skipper of Australia Under-19, says that they are happy to put a score on the board and defend the target. Adds that they need to play some good cricket and win this game. Mentions that they have done well in training, so they need to play some good cricket out in the middle today.
Qasim Akram the skipper of Pakistan Under-19, says that they will bowl first. He says that the wicket looks good so they need to play attacking cricket. Adds that their preparation has been good.

Australia Under-19 (Playing XI) - Teague Wyllie, Campbell Kellaway, Corey Miller, Cooper Connolly (C), Lachlan Shaw (In for Isaac Higgins), William Salzmann, Aidan Cahill, Tobias Snell (WK), Jack Sinfield (In for Joshua Garner), Tom Whitney (In for Harkirat Bajwa), Jack Nisbet.
Pakistan Under-19 (Playing XI) - Muhammad Shehzad, Abbas Ali, Haseebullah Khan (WK), Awais Ali, Ahmed Khan, Abdul Faseeh, Maaz Sadaqat, Qasim Akram (C), Irfan Khan, Mehran Mumtaz, Zeeshan Zameer.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Pakistan Under-19. They have elected to BOWL first.

Also, PERTH SCORCHERS have been crowned Big Bash champions. This is the 4th time they have won it and also the third time they have beaten the Sixers in the finals. Have to say, they were the best team throughout and by a mile.

For Pakistan Under-19, it is going to be a test for their batters as Australia Under-19 have some quality pacers in their ranks. One believes the team that bats well will actually come out on top. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

Australia Under-19 finished second in their group. They lost to the Lankans and their downfall in that game was against spin and that will be their test here too. The game could well be decided on the basis of how they play spin.

How good was the game last evening? Hope you’ll see over it because today, we have two teams that usually provide nail-bitters at the grandest stage. It is Pakistan Under-19 taking on Australia Under-19. We already have two semi-finalists and we will have our third by the end of this game. Who will it be? We will find out.
